description: This file contains JavaScript code for handling asynchronous operations in SuiteCRM, including calendar and RPC client functionalities, with licensing and contact information in comments.

classes.name: SugarVCalClient
classes.description: Client class for handling calendar synchronization and free/busy data parsing.

classes.name: SugarRPCClient
classes.description: Client class for making RPC calls to the server with allowed methods like retrieve, query, save, etc.

methods.name: method_callback
methods.description: Handles the response from asynchronous requests, updating widgets based on the result.

methods.name: SugarVCalClient.load
methods.description: Loads calendar data for a specific user and request ID, updating global free/busy registries.

methods.name: SugarVCalClient.parseResults
methods.description: Parses calendar free/busy data from server response, adjusting for timezone and daylight saving.

methods.name: SugarRPCClient.call_method
methods.description: Performs an RPC call to the server with specified method and arguments, supporting synchronous and asynchronous modes.
